declared_decision.decision_time_original: Conversation receipt; authoritative timestamp not independently attested
declared_decision.normalization_basis: Explicit current instruction names owner adoption; original enum retained. No general enum mapping or inferred V2 acceptance.
declared_decision.owner_identity: User-declared sole developer and operator; independently unverified
declared_decision.rationale: No additional rationale supplied beyond acceptance subject to safeguards

predecessor_template.relationship: Additive acceptance submission after blank template; original unchanged, not overwritten or backdated
